text.tspan: CloudFront origins: where the edge fetches content from
• Distribute files and cache them at the edge
• Upload files to S3 THROUGH CloudFront
• Apps in VPC private subnets: no need
to expose them on the internet
it is a custom origin, so NO OAC
• Any public HTTP backend you want
OAC vs OAI (how CloudFront proves itself to a private S3 bucket)
